tech.route: Right after the gates, Tech's desk area is immediately in front of you.

business_dev.route: From the gates, walk left along the main aisle — the big Business Dev cluster is along the top wall; more Business Dev clusters sit in the middle rows.

hr.route: Walk left along the main aisle to the middle of the floor — Human Resources has two clusters there, one behind the other.

hr_marq.route: Walk left along the aisle almost to the end — Marq HR is the small cluster in the back row on the far-left side.

hr_operations.route: Walk left along the aisle almost to the end — HR Operations is the small cluster next to Marq HR in the back row.

it.route: Walk left along the main aisle — IT's desks are along the top wall, past Business Dev, next to Eclatic.

eclatic.route: Walk left along the main aisle to the far end — Eclatic's desks are the first cluster along the top wall.

finance.route: Walk left along the main aisle to the far end, then turn down into the wing — Finance fills the wing's desk rows.

l_and_d.route: From the gates, head right past the elevators — the L&D room is the big room at the top-right corner with the three round tables.

kitchen.route: The kitchen is right next to the elevators — fridge and microwaves are there.

elevators.route: Head back through the gates — the 3 elevators are right there.

stairs_main.route: From the gates, go past the elevators — the stairs are just beside them.

toilets.route: From the gates, walk left along the top wall — the WC block is a short walk down, before the offices.

offices.route: The private offices are along the top wall, past the WC block, toward the far end.

meeting_rooms.route: Walk left along the main aisle all the way — the meeting rooms are on the far-left wall. There's also one at the end of the Finance wing.

eclatic_meeting_rooms.route: Walk left along the main aisle to the far end — the Eclatic meeting rooms are the room at the top-left corner.

gates.route: You're at the entrance — the face ID gates, right after the elevators.
